why: Suspected active pulmonary TB with a right upper lobe cavitary lesion, still on airborne isolation with AFB smears #2/#3 and TB PCR pending, and Infectious Disease has not cleared isolation, so OTH-4 (isolation exclusion) and FORM-X4 (TB not cleared by a doctor/ID) are not met.
traps: Referral form says 'PPD/TB: chest X-ray negative' but the radiology report shows a 3.2 cm right upper lobe cavitary lesion concerning for active TB (OTH-4, FORM-X4).
Form and fax cover call it pneumonia; the H&P and ID consult treat it as suspected pulmonary tuberculosis.
One negative AFB smear is not clearance; ID requires 3 negative smears and negative PCR.
